name: Boiled Batter Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Sift together a pint of flour and a teaspoonful of baking powder into a deep dish
Sprinkle in a little salt, adding also a tablespoonful of melted butter
Stir into this gradually a pint of milk; when quite smooth, add four eggs, yolks and whites beaten separately
Add enough more flour to make a very stiff batter
If liked, any kind of fruit may be stirred into this; a pint of berries or sliced fruit
Serve with cream and sugar, wine sauce, or any sweet sauce

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift together a pint of flour and a teaspoonful of baking powder into a deep dish
2. Sprinkle in a little salt, adding also a tablespoonful of melted butter
3. Stir into this gradually a pint of milk; when quite smooth, add four eggs, yolks and whites beaten separately
4. Add enough more flour to make a very stiff batter
5. If liked, any kind of fruit may be stirred into this; a pint of berries or sliced fruit
6. Boil two hours
7. Serve with cream and sugar, wine sauce, or any sweet sauce
